defaults.description: Filled into a match made from this template, or from a competition that uses it, when the match has none. Not the user's role: that depends on the match.

id.description: The id from the URL; can be left out.

version.description: The version last seen, when updating. Leave it out to create the record.

description: A MatchTemplate as a client sends it to save it: the server sets updatedAt and deletedAt, and version only goes with an update.
